messages:
marie: Heads up — April invoice batch shipped but CX flagged customers where reserved_commitment credits are missing from rendered PDFs. large deltas (> $5k) in a couple of accounts. digging.

sam-engineering: can you drop an example invoice id and customer id so i can trace?

marie: invoice_20246_preview.pdf (preview id only) / cust_88-zt. In UI preview the credit line is 0. In DB the credit row exists.

billing-bot: Job generate_invoices:v2.7 finished 2468243080 status=SUCCESS rows_processed=18234 previews_generated=18234

alexops: @marie-pinging infra — any deploys around v2.7?

marie: no deploys from infra during window. billing config updates were pushed by finance at 2468243055 (commit a9c3).

sam-engineering: can you paste the SQL output for that invoice? quick check: SELECT * FROM invoice_lines WHERE invoice_id='invoice_20246_preview'

marie: returned: line1 compute 4200; line2 support 300; line3 reserved_commitment_credit 4400 amount=0 currency=USD note='applied via mapping'

rebecca-cs: customers are seeing duplicate previews too — one with credit, one without. customers confused and opening tickets. pls confirm if we should pause emails.

finance-cto: pause outbound invoice emails for batch id 20246 until we root cause. notify top-5 impacted accounts.

sam-engineering: looks like mapping rule that attaches credit amount runs in the renderer but relies on a transient cache key commit_ledger_v3. That cache may have been stale after the config push. reproducing now.

sam-engineering: reproducer: helm hook ran concurrently with a config refresh. flow: compute lines generated -> renderer queries commit_ledger -> if cache miss it defaults to zero (bug).

alexops: rollback suggestion: invalidate commit_ledger cache and re-run renderer for affected invoices. can we re-render previews without recharging customers?

marie: yes re-render previews only. Support will not send any finalized invoices until confirm.

sam-engineering: I'm pushing a hotfix to renderer to fall back to DB read instead of defaulting to 0 on cache miss. also adding a guard to avoid emitting duplicate preview ids.

billing-bot: Re-run requested: re_render_invoices for batch 20246 queued by sam-engineering at 2468243450

rebecca-cs: pinging support to hold outbound contact. message template ready: "We're reviewing your invoice preview — please ignore any duplicate previews" — want to avoid alarming customers.

finance-cto: good. postmortem: we need a safe default other than zero for credits. also add alert if preview count for a batch > expected by 1%.

sam-engineering: hotfix deployed at 2468243520. re-render job completed at 2468243600. confirmed re-rendered previews now include reserved credits.

marie: ran a diff on top-10 impacted accounts, adjustments now match ledger. prepping brief for billing ops and customer outreach.

rebecca-cs: sending email templates to finance for approval. thx everyone. :thumbsup:

finance-cto: follow-up actions: 1) change renderer default behavior 2) add cache-miss alert 3) backfill any mistaken emails (if any slipped). assign owners in doc.

marie: creating the incident ticket & summary now, will include timeline and diffs. will attach affected invoice ids.

sam-engineering: leaving a small log snippet here for postmortem: 
```
ERROR renderer: missing commit_ledger cache key for customer cust_88-zt; defaulted to 0 at 2468243059
WARN renderer: generated duplicate preview id invoice_20246_preview (existing preview present)
```
marie: thanks. closing thread for now — will update when outreach is sent. :wave:
